summary: The Corruption Core is the heart of Discord’s corruption engine — a volatile nexus where raw Discord energy condenses into living corruption. Muramite engineers and Discord-forged entities harvest, refine, and weaponize the corruption that spreads across the plains.
history: Formed when Discord energy condensed into a stable corruption nexus.
Muramite engineers constructed siphons to extract corruption essence.
War-Shades were first empowered here with refined corruption.
Corruption waves radiated outward, reshaping the Fracture Plains.
